abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Wishing Star
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Jirachi is your Active Pokémon, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. Jirachi and your other Active Pokémon, if any, are now Asleep. This power can't be used if Jirachi is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Metallic Blow
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Poké-Bodies, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Wobbuffet by your opponent's Pokémon-ex.

attacks.name: Flip Over
attacks.text: Wobbuffet does 10 damage to itself, and don't apply Weakness and Resistance to this damage.

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.name: Team Aqua Hideout
effect: Each Pokémon that does not have Team Aqua in its name pays {Colorless} more to retreat.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

text.name: Scott
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 cards in any combination of Supporter cards and Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Wally's Training
effect: Search your deck for a card that evolves from your Active Pokémon (choose 1 if there are 2) and put it on your Active Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Pow! Hand Extension
effect: You may use this card only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent.

Move 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Or, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch.

text.name: Rocket's Admin.
effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player counts his or her Prize cards left and draws up to that many cards. (You draw your cards first.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Metal Energy
effect: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't {Metal}. Metal Energy provides {Metal} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

text.name: TV Reporter
effect: Draw 3 cards. Then discard any 1 card from your hand.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Island Cave
effect: Whenever any player attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to Water Pokémon, Fighting Pokémon, or Metal Pokémon, remove any Special Conditions from that Pokémon.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

text.name: Energy Removal 2
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

text.name: Steven's Advice
effect: Draw a number of cards up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play.
If you have 7 or more cards (including this one) in your hand, you can't play this card.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Swoop! Teleporter
effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex) and switch it with 1 of your Basic Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex) in play. (Any cards attached to that Pokémon, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) Place the first Basic Pokemon in the discard pile. Shuffle your deck afterward.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Wise Aura
abilities.text: As long as Medicham ex is your Active Pokémon, each Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex) (both yours and your opponent's) can't use any Poké-Powers.

attacks.name: Pure Power
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Sky Kick
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has Fighting Resistance, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage.

rules.label: Pokémon-ex rule
rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Pokémon Reversal
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch.
